gloss: with heavy clumsy footsteps; clomping; stomping

definitions.gloss: with loud, heavy footsteps; clomping around noisily
definitions.explanation: The sound or manner of heavy, clumsy footsteps — people running or walking noisily, as on a wooden floor or stairs. Often suggests a lack of grace or of consideration for the noise.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どたどた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧どたどた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{足音|あしおと}→足音：02991_ashioto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There are heavy footsteps stomping around upstairs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どたどた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Running down the hallway with heavy footsteps disturbs the people on the floor below.

notes:
Imitates loud, heavy, clumsy footsteps — typically of someone running or hurrying noisily indoors. Usually carries a slightly negative tone of clumsiness or inconsideration. Often used as どたどた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どたどた(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run with heavy footsteps
- どたどた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to clomp around

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ばたばた→ばたばた：05353_batabata⟧: hurried, busy movement or flapping; emphasizes rushed busyness more than heavy footfalls
- ⟦どすどす→どすどす：29090_dosudosu⟧: even heavier, more thudding footsteps
